source: KSQAAC Spardha Yashassu NMMS Study Material 2022, MAT Chapter 20 (questions: PDF pages 63–65, key: PDF pages 145–146)

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many times does an even number come immediately after a prime number?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks. 1 is not a prime number.

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many times does an odd number come between two even numbers?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the series below, looking at three numbers in a row, how many times does an even number come between two prime numbers?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many times does an odd number come immediately after a factor of 4?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks. The factors of 4 are 1, 2 and 4.

questions.prompt: In the series below, looking at three numbers in a row, how many times does an even number greater than 3 come between two odd numbers?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the letter series below, looking at three letters in a row, how many times does a consonant come between two vowels?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks. The vowels are A, E, I, O and U.
questions.working: They are: A M E, O Q U, E W O. That makes 3.

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many pairs of neighbouring numbers differ by 3?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.
questions.note: Hidden until checked: there are 9 such pairs (the book's diagram misses the 3 6 in “7 3 3 6”), and 9 is not an option. Counting only rises of 3 gives 6, and only falls of 3 gives 3; neither is the key's 8.

questions.prompt: In the letter series below, which is the 6th letter to the left of the 8th letter from the left?
questions.rule: Count 8 letters from the left to find the 8th letter, then count 6 more to its left.
questions.working: The 8th letter is M; the 6th letter to its left is G (the 2nd from the left)

questions.prompt: In the letter series below, how many times does the letter K come immediately after a vowel?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.
questions.working: They are: E K, U K, A K. That makes 3.

questions.prompt: In the series below, looking at three numbers in a row, how many times does a square number come between two odd numbers?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks. 0 counts as a square number (0 × 0).

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many times does an odd number come immediately after a square number?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the letter series below, how many times does the letter p come between two vowels?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.
questions.working: They are: o p a, e p o, o p o. That makes 3.

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many pairs of neighbouring numbers do not add up to 5?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the series below, what is the third number to the left of the number exactly in the middle?
questions.rule: The series has 27 numbers, so the middle one is the 14th (13 numbers on each side).
questions.working: The 14th number is 9. Three places to its left is the 11th number: 4

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many pairs of neighbouring numbers are both prime?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.
questions.note: The book's key says D (2), but it misses the last pair, 3 5, so there are 3 pairs.

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many 2s have a square number immediately before and immediately after them?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many 7s come immediately after 8 but are not immediately followed by 3?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the series below, how many 2s are immediately followed by 1 but not immediately preceded by 4?
questions.rule: Go through the series one place at a time and mark every place that fits, then count the marks.

questions.prompt: In the letter series below, how many consonants are in a prime-numbered place? (Count places from the first letter.)
questions.rule: Number the letters 1, 2, 3 … from the first. The prime places are 2, 3, 5, 7 and 11.
questions.working: Places 2 B, 3 C, 5 E, 7 G, 11 K. E is a vowel, so the consonants are B, C, G, K. That makes 4.

questions.prompt: In the letter series below, how many vowels are in a place that is a multiple of 2? (Count places from the first letter.)
questions.rule: Number the letters 1, 2, 3 … from the first, and look at the even places.
questions.working: The vowels in even places are e (6), i (10) and u (22). That makes 3.
